items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: It was secular, the same as the Bach Chorale had a seculars form, too.

ctx.x: That's the word I wanted. Yeah. It was secular, the same as the Bach Chorale had a seculars form, too. You know, there was many chorales, even written during Bach's time, on the secular music. They turned around and made it religious. But really, the beginning of it was from the minne-singers and the heralds and the people, the jongleurs, that travelled around singing. So, and the same way with the black music.
But how did you, for instance, in Harlem in 1923, with a band, how did you look on the blues singers?
